summary: Lolo NF lookout on Eddy Peak, Sanders County, MT: 1931 L-4 house, present R-6 cab 1982; NHLR-registered 2009; manned in summer; gated road, visiting hours per a commercial operator.

facts.design: R-6 flat-topped cab, 15 by 15 feet, with catwalk on a 10-foot concrete base (present tower); first station an L-4 ground house, 1931

staffing.status: manned for the season in 2020 per the Sanders County Ledger; NHLR says still staffed every season (undated); no 2025-2026 staffing source found

access.note: Gated road about 0.7 mile below the top, then a 170-yard shale trail, per a commercial operator. Operator lists visiting hours of 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., six days a week, when operating; not verified with the Forest Service. Level is my judgment.

visit.trail_note: Gate about 0.7 mile from the top; about 170 yards on a shale trail to the tower (operator description)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Build years differ only because the sources date different structures. The first station was built in 1931 (NHLR, firelookout.com, the 1931 newspaper, the 2020 Ledger). The present R-6 cab went up in 1982. The record's 1982 is the present tower.

notes_for_editor: Distance conflict left open: firelookout.com says 8 miles southeast of Thompson Falls, the 2020 Ledger says about 21 miles southeast. The visiting hours and gate description come from a commercial operator's page and are not verified with the Forest Service; the access level is my judgment. The lookout was confirmed staffed in 2020 only; NHLR's still-staffed statement is undated. Record's height_m 3.0 is not carried (no sourced overall height). Reads: 6 pages and 2 searches. Brief's build year 1982 is the present cab, which the sources support.
